summary.paired_energy_scope: Only pairs completing all 160 s; incomplete trials are reported separately.
summary.diagnostic_note: Constraint checks during planning use 2 s output times. Post-experiment audits replay every executed control on a 0.1 s output grid. Neither grid provides a continuous-time or stochastic feasibility guarantee.

sensitivity.timing_note: Local wall-clock planning times include PDE validation and first-use compilation where needed. The two model-comparison calls also capture candidate snapshots; sampling-count calls do not. These are indicative offline timings.

numerical_validation.note: Same initial field and controls; spatial refinement is a sensitivity check, not an exact solution.
